einzeiler: The history of the planet Armageddon and the rise of the Ork warlord Ghazghkull Thraka
kurzfassung: This episode explores the brutal history and geography of the Imperial hive world Armageddon. It details the origins of the legendary Commissar Yarrick and how the colossal Ork leader Ghazghkull Thraka rose to power. Finally, it sets the stage for the Second War for Armageddon as a massive space hulk approaches the planet.
stichpunkte: Armageddon sits on the former site of Ullanor, relocated by the Mechanicum using experimental teleportation technology.
The planet functions as a massive, heavily polluted industrial hive world producing critical military supplies.
The Steel Legion is introduced as a uniquely mobile mechanized Imperial Guard force built to fight across Armageddon's toxic environment.
Commissar Sebastian Yarrick survived an early Ork invasion as a child and developed a fierce, tactical hatred for the green-skinned xenos.
Ghazghkull Thraka rose from a dying world after experiencing a shared vision from Gork and Mork alongside the painboy.
Ghazghkull united all Ork clans and traveled across the galaxy aboard a massive space hulk while gathering immense strength and numbers.
The space hulk World Killer arrived at Armageddon in M41, ignored by the arrogant planetary leader Herman von Straub despite obvious Ork activity.

kapitel.titel: The Geography and History of Armageddon
The Arrival of the Space Hulk

clips.hook: Teleporting a planet into the sun
clips.text: The Mechanicum was instructed to destroy the planet Ullanor by teleporting its core directly into a star, but instead relocated it to the Segmentum Solar to hide their actions.

clips.hook: A population of 500 billion on an 86 percent Earth-sized rock
clips.text: Armageddon spans roughly eighty-six percent of Earth's size while housing an estimated population of up to 500 billion individuals.

clips.hook: The absolute death sentence of Imperial penal colonies
clips.text: Penal colonies on Armageddon serve as fatal labor camps where convicts are sent to work in active volcanoes until they die.
Instructors at the Schola Progenium recognized Yarrick's extreme fearlessness and immediately assigned him to the brutal role of a commissar.

clips.hook: Orks and daemons having a high-five party in the warp
clips.text: As the space hulk phased in and out of reality during warp travel, Orks and daemons briefly interacted before returning to endless combat.

beschreibung:
On today’s cast we begin our coverage of the 2nd war of Armageddon (seriously this place sucks!). With an opening on the planet itself, how it got there, how it is structured, and why it is so important. Then we jump (obviously) into the Steel Legion and their value to the imperium, as well as their unique way of “adhering” to the codex. From there we jump over to the origin story of the great and only Yarrick!! Only to then talk about the equally amazing but greener Ghaz! We then close out talking about the arrival of Ghaz and the orks on Armageddon.
